name: Shokushu no Yakata ~Kairaku ni Torawareru Joshikousei~
original_name: 触手の館 ～快楽に捕らわれる女子校生～
source:
A revenge tale about a bullied student who fuses with something otherworldly...

Squirming tendrils are the living bondage that he can summon at will
to tentacle r*pe the girls who kept him down.

* Story

I was always teased at school, and no one helped me.
I cleared my head by taking walks in the desolate "lost woods",
where one day I came across a mansion.
Inside were tentacles... and they seemed to like me.

Like a deer in headlights I froze while the tentacles lunged.
I expected to die right there.

But the tentacles stopped.
"What? You're not going to eat me?" Of course the tentacles said nothing.
"Well," I ventured, "maybe you can listen to my story."

Later, it happened that some of the girls who teased me stepped into that mansion.
The tentacles attacked them. "I guess you sympathize with me...
Well then, maybe I could borrow your power?"
That's how I made an unlikely friendship... and began my revenge.

* Tentacles ravish heroines who can't escape!
* The protagonist wields bondage-like tentacles in scenes of face rape,
defloration, anal, double penetration, and more. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE138950.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个关于一个被欺负的学生与超凡脱俗的东西融合的复仇故事……

蠕动的卷须是他可以随意召唤的活生生的束缚
触手强奸那些让他失望的女孩。

* 故事

我在学校总是被嘲笑，没有人帮助我。
我在荒凉的“失落的树林”里散步来清醒头脑，
有一天我在那里遇到了一栋豪宅。
里面有触手……它们似乎很喜欢我。

就像头灯下的鹿一样，当触手猛扑时我僵住了。
我原以为会死在那里。

但触手停了下来。
“什么？你不吃我吗？”当然，触手什么也没说。
“好吧，”我大胆地说，“也许你可以听听我的故事。”

后来，恰巧有几个戏弄我的女孩子踏进了那栋宅子。
触手袭击了他们。“我猜你是同情我的……
那么，也许我可以借用你的力量？”
就这样我建立了一段不太可能的友谊……并开始了我的复仇。

* 触手迷惑女主角，无法逃脱！
* 主角在脸部强奸的场景中挥舞着束缚般的触手，
摘花、肛交、双插等等。
